findings.title: Left Thumb Impression Forgery: Synthetic Ridge Pattern & Ink Discontinuity
findings.description: Forensic biometric analysis indicates the primary party left thumb impression is a synthetic/counterfeit print. Ridge line flow shows abrupt artificial termination, absence of epidermal pore sweat structures, and uniform pixel opacity inconsistent with natural ink transfer.
findings.evidence: Galton point failure; 0 authentic ridge bifurcations; uniform pixel opacity

findings.title: Right Thumb Impression Forgery: Spliced Ridge Discontinuity & Tampered Minutiae
findings.description: Forensic examination confirms the secondary thumb impression is digitally spliced. High-frequency boundary halo artifacts, disrupted ridge flow vectors, and anomalous Error Level Analysis (ELA) compression noise verify a copied/forged imprint.
findings.evidence: Perimeter gradient step 4.8x; abrupt ridge termination vectors; ELA discrepancy

recommendations: Subject the physical document to microscopic inspection under oblique lighting to examine paper fibers and physical erasing.
Cross-reference the Registration Number, Deed Date, and Consideration Amount with the State Department of Registrations and Stamps portal.
